scope: Static review of frozen provider r3 health binding and module lifecycle delta; no phone or model requests by reviewer
findings: Original owner request remains exact in final model user text; request hash is independent of native TurnRequest hash.
Health template binds original request hash, single nonce and known session/profile; binding is exclusively consumed once.
Final-only grammar does not force summary nonce; independent validation requires exact raw model nonce.
Decision and native-frame emission separately forbid phone tools; health skips original sidecar inspections.
Health outcome requires one original HTTP200/stop response, matching raw body/response/decision, joined worker and idle slot.
Native task completion remains separately authoritative and health never claims business success.
Final module r3 source retains identity/PGID/starttime admission and stop ordering; only observed BusyBox signal syntax changed after the release-path update.
